basics.name: Shilpa Mishra
basics.label: Software Developer | Web and Mobile | B.Tech CSE
basics.summary: Software developer with a B.Tech in Computer Science (CGPA 8.03, First Division with Distinction) and experience across mobile and web development, freelance projects and international recruiting. Builds practical tools for her own work, communicates daily with UK clients, and can join immediately.

work.name: JobBridge Recruitment (Aligner Talent Solutions LLP)
highlights: Managed end-to-end job applications for 15-20 international clients seeking roles in the UK, tailoring and submitting 45-60 job-specific resumes and applications every day (3 per client per day).
Rewrote each client's resume to match the job description's required skills, certifications and job title, across IT, healthcare, finance, supply chain, pharmacy and biotech roles.
Sourced openings daily with advanced Boolean and Google X-ray search across LinkedIn, NHS Jobs and company job boards, filtering by seniority, salary and visa sponsorship.
Prepared interview notes and ran mock interviews for every client invited to interview; clients received about 7 interview invitations a week combined.
Built SourcingStudio Pro, a browser app that generates LinkedIn Boolean and Google X-ray search strings from clickable filters, replacing hand-typed searches in the daily workflow.
Kept clients updated by email and phone every day and tracked each client's applications and interviews in Excel and Google Sheets.

work.name: Freelance
highlights: Built websites, Shopify stores and WordPress pages for local businesses, including product catalogues that let them take orders from online customers.
Helped 18 local businesses build their online presence, from first website to a working online store.

work.name: Hawk Aerospace
highlights: Built the user interface of an agricultural-drone startup's Android app in React Native, working in Android Studio with Java and Gradle.
Maintained documentation of the app's frontend for future developers.
Built 58 app screens and fixed about 98 production bugs, counted from the project's code history.

projects.name: SourcingStudio Pro
projects.summary: Boolean job-search builder
highlights: Built a single-file web app that turns job searches into clickable building blocks and generates LinkedIn Boolean and Google X-ray strings, with seniority, salary and visa filters, a length meter for LinkedIn's query limit, saved search profiles and a CSV job tracker.

projects.name: Vibrant Kashi
projects.summary: Varanasi travel guide (final-year project)
highlights: Built a travel guide to Varanasi as a solo final-year project: React pages for ghats, temples, museums, historic places, hotels, restaurants, events and adventure, with embedded Google Maps, visitor reviews with star ratings, and an Express and MongoDB backend with JWT login.

projects.name: Sorting Visualizer
projects.summary: animated sorting algorithms
highlights: Built an animated visualiser for bubble, merge, quick and heap sort in React and Redux, deployed on GitHub Pages.

projects.name: Pathfinding Visualizer
projects.summary: graph search on a grid
highlights: Built an interactive grid that animates pathfinding algorithms (Dijkstra, A*, BFS, DFS, bidirectional search) and recursive-division maze generation.

projects.name: Wealth-Wise
projects.summary: Personal finance app with AI receipt scanning, budgets, recurring transactions and monthly email reports
highlights: Built personal finance app with AI receipt scanning, budgets, recurring transactions and monthly email reports: Receipt scanning: upload a photo and the Gemini API extracts amount, date and category; Budgets with email alerts when spending nears the limit, and monthly reports by email (Resend).

projects.name: Find My Car
projects.summary: Car marketplace with AI image search, test-drive booking and an admin dashboard
highlights: Built car marketplace with AI image search, test-drive booking and an admin dashboard: AI image search: upload a car photo to find similar cars in stock (Gemini API); Filters by make, body type, fuel, transmission and price, plus saved cars.

projects.name: WhisperWave
projects.summary: Real-time chat app with login, profile photos, user search and instant messaging
highlights: Built real-time chat app with login, profile photos, user search and instant messaging: Real-time messaging and online status with Socket.io; Sign-up and login with JWT and bcrypt-hashed passwords; profile photos.

projects.name: Learnify
projects.summary: Learning platform where instructors publish video courses and students enrol, pay and track progress
highlights: Built learning platform where instructors publish video courses and students enrol, pay and track progress: Two roles: instructors create, edit and publish courses and lessons; students browse, enrol and learn; Stripe checkout to buy a course; free preview lessons for everyone.

projects.name: Restaurant Ordering App
projects.summary: Food-ordering site with restaurant and menu management, cart, Stripe payments and email verification
highlights: Built food-ordering site with restaurant and menu management, cart, Stripe payments and email verification: Accounts with email verification (6-digit code), password reset and admin or user roles; Restaurant and menu management with image uploads.

projects.name: Rental Household
projects.summary: Marketplace for renting household items, with admin and user dashboards and online payments
highlights: Built marketplace for renting household items, with admin and user dashboards and online payments: Admin dashboard to create categories and products with photos; User dashboard with profile and orders.

projects.name: Food Delivery Website
projects.summary: Food delivery frontend with menu categories, cart and checkout pages
highlights: Built food delivery frontend with menu categories, cart and checkout pages: Explore menu by category and add dishes to the cart; Cart with quantities and totals, shared across pages with React Context.

projects.name: Stock Chart Dashboard
projects.summary: Take-home assessment: a responsive page that charts company stock data from a CSV file
highlights: Built take-home assessment: a responsive page that charts company stock data from a CSV file: Loads and parses the CSV in the browser with PapaParse; Company list on the left; clicking one draws its chart with Chart.js.

projects.name: Weatherly
projects.summary: Weather app that shows current conditions for any city
highlights: Built weather app that shows current conditions for any city: Search any city and see its current temperature and conditions, with an icon that matches the weather.

projects.name: Resume Screening and Job Matching
projects.summary: Parses resumes, sorts them into job categories and recommends jobs, with a small web app
highlights: Built parses resumes, sorts them into job categories and recommends jobs, with a small web app: Resume parsing: extracts contact details, skills and education with NLP; Categorisation: a machine-learning model assigns each resume to a job category (Kaggle resume dataset).

projects.name: Phishing Website Detection
projects.summary: Classifies web pages as phishing or legitimate from their HTML
highlights: Built classifies web pages as phishing or legitimate from their HTML: Byte-pair-encoding tokenizer trained on page HTML, with TF-IDF features; Random forest classifier trained on labelled phishing and legitimate pages.

projects.name: Breast Cancer Detection (CNN)
projects.summary: Convolutional neural network that classifies breast biopsy images
highlights: Built convolutional neural network that classifies breast biopsy images: Four-class (normal, benign, in-situ, invasive) and binary (carcinoma or not) classification; Multi-scale CNN that looks at both cell-level detail and tissue structure.

projects.name: Customer Churn Prediction
projects.summary: Predicts whether telecom customers will churn, stay or join, comparing five models
highlights: Built predicts whether telecom customers will churn, stay or join, comparing five models: Data: 7,043 customers of a California telecom company, with demographics, services and tenure; Five models compared: XGBoost, logistic regression, random forest, decision tree and naive Bayes.

projects.name: Predict Future Sales
projects.summary: Forecasts next month's sales for a Kaggle competition
highlights: Built forecasts next month's sales for a Kaggle competition: Feature engineering on daily sales: monthly totals, lags and item and shop statistics; Gradient-boosting model (XGBoost) with tuning.

projects.name: Stock Market Forecasting
projects.summary: Notebook that forecasts Apple's share price from historical data
highlights: Built notebook that forecasts Apple's share price from historical data: Historical price analysis and a forecasting model on Apple (AAPL) data.

projects.name: Object Detection in the Browser
projects.summary: Detects objects in images and webcam video, running entirely in the browser
highlights: Built detects objects in images and webcam video, running entirely in the browser: Live webcam and image detection with boxes and labels, using the COCO-SSD model in TensorFlow.js.

projects.name: AI Chatbot
projects.summary: A chatbot web app on the OpenAI chat API
highlights: Built a chatbot web app on the OpenAI chat API: Chat interface in Gradio that keeps the conversation history and sends it to the OpenAI API.

projects.name: Real-Time Network Traffic Analyzer
projects.summary: Captures network packets and streams them live to a web dashboard
highlights: Built captures network packets and streams them live to a web dashboard: Packet capture with Scapy, filtered by IP address; Live dashboard in Next.js fed over a WebSocket.

projects.name: Password Strength Tester and Cracker
projects.summary: Java tool that generates passwords, rates their strength and simulates brute-force cracking
highlights: Built java tool that generates passwords, rates their strength and simulates brute-force cracking: Generate, rate and crack: strength scoring by length and character variety, and a brute-force simulation that shows the time to crack.
